notes:
## Changes
- **Favourites.** Every scene tile has a heart beside its stars: click it (or press F) to make the scene a favourite. Favourites are your own pick, separate from the star rating.
- **A Favourites view.** The main window now has Home | Folders | Scenes | Favourites (Ctrl+4), listing every favourite scene with the usual filters, sort and tile size.
- **Random wall.** In the Favourites view, Random wall fills the Media Wall with a random selection of your favourites, with the rest waiting in its queue.
- **Favourites on phones and tablets.** The phone page has a Favourites tab, and favourite scenes show a heart.
- Add or take out several scenes at once with Favourite on the selection bar, or from a scene's right-click menu.
- Scroll bars stand out: a grey track with a plum handle that is never too small to grab, even on very long lists.
- The folder and scene lists keep a small gap before the scroll bar, so a selection can be started from the right-hand edge.
- Scenes: Online only is now on by default, as it is for folders. The list also updates when a drive is connected or removed.
- Sync 5-star scenes to Favourites has been removed, along with its Favourites folder setting. Files it copied before are left where they are.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
